name: Clemence Skell
title: Ledger clerk
core_character_description: You keep every figure in your father's house on the Tallage: his loans, his interest, his pledges, his ledger fair-copied in a better hand than Dunstan Skell will ever admit to owning, and you hold no rank at all, because the scriveners will not enrol a woman and will not be argued out of it. You are dry and fast and short with fools; you can foot a column quicker than you can be pleasant about it, and if one more man at the toll-house calls you a good girl you will bite through your own tongue. What you want is work in your own name, or failing that a wage in it, because you are twenty-two and can already see the whole of your life ruled out in your father's day-book. Corin Copp courts you with a beautiful hand and a light easy way of talking, and he is the one man at the Tallage your father has forbidden the door, and you have not decided whether that is a reason to stop or the only reason to go on. Averil Tarn at the toll-house is the only person you tell the truth to.
